message: Someone needs to do something about t- netixs i have a pre paid account with them and they are very unprofessional. I receive calls from my husband in jail and i spend alot of money to talk to him. However t-netix takes there time posting funds to accounts to were as though there are times i can not speak to my husband all weekend because they dont post money to accounts on time i put 30.00 on my account on Dec 23, 2007 so i would be able to speak with my husband on christmas day and he would at least be able to hear our small children open there gifts t- netixs did not post that money on our account until later christmas day this is not the first time they do this often and when you try to speak to a supervisor you never can. You can call to discuss an issue and at times they put on a recording saying systems are down and call back later when they know they are doing people wrong this has to stop i feel like telling them they get no more money from me but they already know this is the only way we can talk to our love ones so they do it and not care. I cant wait until my husband gets out tnetixs can kiss his mine and our kids ass!!!!!!!
